ns2:section.sectionText: Restricted to students in the DPI program. Email pdq@illinois.edu for the override. The students will demonstrate their proficiency in food product development through a team-based design project proposed by Griffith Foods, a client of the Discovery Partners Institute (DPI). The team will be required to develop a new alternative protein (plant, micro, insect, cellular) snacking food product idea designed to meet target protein nutrition requirements for children. This product must fulfill the Sustainability and Health & Nutrition goals outlined by Griffith Foods.
